text:
maria.devx: Quick sync — Acme POC. Need to lock hosting mode + success criteria by EOD Fri. Customer requirement: EU residency, sustained ~50 qps, p95 <200ms, and completed security questionnaire. Any blockers?

tom.ae: thanks — client asked about cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated. Also timeline if we go Dedicated.

arun.presales: short answer: Dedicated gives predictable throughput and isolation. Ballpark lead time 4–6 weeks for reserved capacity in a new EU pool; pricing depends on commit level. For a 50 qps profile we recommend 8x A100-equivalent slots (estimate). Can share a rough quote.

lee.se: suggestion: run a 2-week hosted pilot in eu-central-1 to validate prompts and evals, then transition to Dedicated for SLA and residency if metrics look good. That reduces up-front cost and accelerates demo.

maria.devx: @arun.presales can you produce a one-pager with cost ranges (hosted vs 3 commit tiers for Dedicated) and the timeline? @lee.se can you draft a short eval plan we can show the customer? :+1:

arun.presales: will do. Quick estimates in-channel for planning: Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ~0.35/token-unit effective for this workload (higher variance). Dedicated (small reserve): ~$12k/mo; medium: ~$28k/mo; large: ~$60k/mo. Lead time: small ~3w, medium 4–6w, large 8–12w depending on capacity and region. Exact quote pending sales ops.

priya.security: security checklist notes: customer requires SOC2, encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (KMS), and IP allowlist. Also they flagged a short questionnaire about data flows and logs. We need to confirm whether Hosted meets their KMS/HSM needs or if Private is required.

maria.devx: good call. I'm attaching the standard SSO/KMS questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/qna/security-poc. Priya — can you own the questionnaire responses?

priya.security: I can take it. Two quick asks: 1) confirm whether we can provide token-level cost breakdown for their finance team, 2) confirm log retention options (we support configurable retention on Dedicated/Private; hosted has 30d by default).

lee.se: for the eval plan, propose these success criteria: 1) end-to-end latency p95 <200ms for user-facing paths, 2) throughput sustain at 50 qps for 15 minutes with <5% error rate, 3) quality: top-3 prompt eval BLEU/accuracy thresholds on provided prompt set, 4) security: questionnaire answered + KMS confirmation. Also include canary rollback plan. I'll paste a minimal config snippet to share with them:

```yaml
poc_plan:
  mode: hosted->dedicated
  initial_region: eu-central-1
  target_qps: 50
  latency_p95_ms: 200
  duration_days: 14
  metrics: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_score]
```

maria.devx: perfect. We'll propose: Phase A (14d hosted pilot, eu-central-1) -> Phase B (Dedicated pilot for 30d if metrics pass). Include automatic rollback and canary.

deploy-bot: Dedicated pool availability check: eu-central-1: available_nodes=8, eta_provision_minutes=420.

arun.presales: that availability looks good for small/medium commits. Tom — I'll slot the quote draft by lunchtime tomorrow.

tom.ae: ok — I'll flag this in the customer call: propose hosted pilot for 2 weeks, then Dedicated pilot if they want residency/SLA. Also will ask finance for their acceptable commit levels.

maria.devx: action items: @arun.presales quote + timeline, @lee.se eval plan and prompt set template, @priya.security questionnaire answers + KMS confirmation. I'll own the customer-facing POC schedule and kickoff doc. Aim to have everything ready by Thursday EOD so we can start pilot next Monday.

lee.se: I'll upload the prompt/eval template to the shared drive and ping the customer for initial prompt set.

priya.security: starting questionnaire now, will ping if I need infra details.

maria.devx: thanks all. If no further blockers I'll post the proposed runbook later today and schedule the kickoff. :rocket:
